title: ConnectorHydraulicActuatorSimple: the Jacobian of the pressure equations analytic
author: Claude-JG
description: The two ODE1 pressure equations of ConnectorHydraulicActuatorSimple are differentiated numerically by CSystem; their derivatives by the pressures, the stroke and its velocity are closed forms. Decided: analytic.
releaseNotes: The two pressure equations of ConnectorHydraulicActuatorSimple have an analytic Jacobian, by the pressures and by the coordinates and velocities of the markers; the Newton iterations are those of the numerical one, the Jacobian is cheaper.
